IF miaomiao_air_monitor.reading(Temperature) > 24 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_cool_on() xiaomi_air_conditioner

IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_on() zhimi_diffuser

IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() xiaomi_air_conditioner
